result_text:
The region ticket list now uses the same ordering as the sales-rep list: high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority.

The change is in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` (around line 10020). I replaced the `ORDER BY t.opened_date, t.id` with `ORDER BY CASE t.priority WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 0 WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, t.opened_date, t.id`, and updated the Javadoc to match. The filters (region, not closed) are unchanged.

I ran `mvn -q -o test -Dtest=RegionManagerTest,ClosedTicketsTest`. It finished with no output, which in quiet mode means success, but I did not confirm the test counts. No test calls this method directly, so the order is not covered by a new test. I did not add one, and nothing was committed.
